data.summary: For this unit’s ranged attacks, re-roll a [Wound result](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) showing 1. When the target is in range of an **[objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)** outside your control, you may re-roll any [Wound result](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) instead.
